K1.policy: Only investors with a valid KYC claim from a trusted issuer may receive tokens.

K3.policy: At least one KYC claim topic must be required.

J1.policy: Investors registered in a restricted country may not receive tokens.

H1.policy: No investor may hold more than the maximum allowed tokens.

H3.policy: The holding-limit module's balance records must match the real token balances.
